checks.detail: final_evaluator.py is a pure, deterministic contract module with frozen slots dataclasses, one public behavior (FinalEvalRequest), explicit error hierarchy, canonical identity derivation and no storage, network, subprocess or real-data access.

14 focused tests cover the valid path, determinism, every fail-closed branch (unfrozen, empty/duplicate/unsorted, wrong hashes, wrong actor types, malformed/missing hashes, wrong identity binding) and the allowed automation actor; tests use only in-memory fake fixtures and never touch real holdout bytes.

Independent spec/quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids p8r2-t2-independent-spec-review-20260810 and p8r2-t2-independent-quality-review-20260810 are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN (not zero).
No blocker exists across the contract, tests, fresh validation result or evidence files; all follow-ups are explicitly non-blocking and deferred to later P8 slices.

Only the two owned mutable files plus T2 evidence receipts are in the change set; no protected user files, TCB modules, authority state, policies, inventories, data or KBase content were modified by the implementation.

advisories.detail: The request payload nests campaign/model/generation/holdout bindings; T3-T5 consumers must use the documented to_payload() shape rather than a flat projection.
